source: unite-db.com/battle_items.json (standard items, precise effects); serebii.net/pokemonunite/battleitems.shtml (unlock levels, event-only items)
notes: One battle item is equipped per match; it is an active button with a cooldown.
cooldownS in seconds. unlockTrainerLevel = account (trainer) level required, not in-match level; null when unite-db does not list it.
Items with mode "event" exist only in limited event modes; Serebii lists most of their cooldowns as "0 Seconds", stored as null (undocumented).
Known disagreements: unlock trainer level Potion 3 (unite-db) vs 4 (Serebii), Goal Getter 17 vs 16; Full Heal cooldown 60 s vs 55 s.
Where unite-db and Serebii disagree (e.g. Full Heal cooldown), unite-db is used for cooldownS and the Serebii value is kept under serebii.

battleItems.name: Eject Button
battleItems.description: Quickly moves forward.

serebii.effect: Quickly moves your Pokémon in the designated direction
serebii.unlock: Trainer Level 11

battleItems.name: Fluffy Tail
battleItems.description: Applies a debuff to the designated wild Pokémon for 3s; disabling the target's attacks. When damaging the debuffed target: deals 100 + 100% Atk + 60% SpAtk + 10 × (Lv. - 1) as additional damage (0.5s CD).

serebii.effect: Stuns Pokémon in front of you for a short time and makes attacks do more damage on them
serebii.unlock: Trainer Level 10

battleItems.name: Full Heal

serebii.effect: Removes all status conditions from your Pokémon and makes it immune to hindrances for a short time.

battleItems.name: Goal Getter

serebii.effect: Doubles goal-scoring speed for a short while

battleItems.name: Goal Hacker
battleItems.description: Tampers with 1 goal zone in range for 4s. If used on an ally goal zone: doubles any shield provided by the goal zone, and strengthens the goal zone's HP restoration rate (restoring HP every 0.5s) for the duration of the effect. If used on an opposing goal zone: disables shield effects and HP restoration from that goal zone for the duration of the effect. Additional applications on an affected goal zone overrides the previous effects and refreshes the duration.

serebii.effect: Strengthe the shield and HP recovery effects of an ally goal zone for a short time when used within or near that goal zone. Nullifies the shield and HP recovery effects of an opposing goal zone for a short time when used within or near that goal zone
serebii.unlock: Aeos Emporuim
